_comment: Rich Semantic SFX & Meme Catalog. Auto-indexed by src/index_sfx.py (Gemini listens to each new audio file + FFmpeg measures exact peak_sec for frame-accurate Remotion alignment).

arcade_bell_ding.sounds_like: Crisp single vintage desk/boxing bell ring ding
arcade_bell_ding.use_when: Instant karma knockouts, clean punchline deliveries, or comedic realization beats

brass_impact_slam.sounds_like: Deep cinematic Inception-style Braam brass impact slam
brass_impact_slam.use_when: Catastrophic raid mechanics (e.g., Naxxramas dance fail, 40-man wipe) or massive explosions

bubble_pop.sounds_like: Crisp viral YouTube/TikTok UI pop-up bubble sound
bubble_pop.use_when: Popping in editorial callout captions, meme icons, or rapid UI highlights

comedy_spring_boing.use_when: Physics anomalies, players bouncing off terrain hitboxes, or trampoline car glitches
comedy_spring_boing.pair_with: Editorial callout caption on bounce apex

comic_thud.sounds_like: Classic cartoon banana-peel slip and slapstick fall impact
comic_thud.use_when: Anticlimactic flop, ragdoll faceplant, or hilarious misstep

correct_ding_meme.sounds_like: Crisp viral game-show correct answer positive bell (Meme Redesign)
correct_ding_meme.use_when: 500 IQ read, smart cooldown usage, or ironic 'called it' moment

crt_glitch_pop.sounds_like: Short digital data burst and CRT static glitch pop
crt_glitch_pop.use_when: TV-static transition wipes between contrasting clips or visual reset cuts

dark_dagger_swoosh.sounds_like: Dark eerie distorted stealth blade whoosh
dark_dagger_swoosh.use_when: Rogue opens from stealth or an enemy jet/threat ambushes from outside camera view

dramatic_hit.sounds_like: Dark cinematic low impact boom hit
dramatic_hit.use_when: Dramatic plot twist, sudden ambush, or heavy combat turn

dun_dun_dun_meme.sounds_like: Classic viral 'Dun Dun Dunn!' dramatic orchestral stinger (Meme Redesign)
dun_dun_dun_meme.use_when: Revealing an approaching elite patrol, stealth rogue, or incoming rocket

fast_rewind.use_when: Instant replay cutbacks ('wait, look at that again') or double-take edits

grizzly_bear_roar.sounds_like: Real vicious wild grizzly bear roar and aggressive low growl
grizzly_bear_roar.use_when: Wild animal ambush, bear cage breach, or ferocious beast attack
grizzly_bear_roar.pair_with: ShakeCue + ZoomCue (mode: snap) on charging bear

heartbeat_sub_pulse.sounds_like: Eerie cinematic tension heartbeat pulse and suspense riser
heartbeat_sub_pulse.use_when: Stalking sequences, low-HP kiting, escort runs, or tense pre-wipe buildup
heartbeat_sub_pulse.pair_with: Gradual ZoomCue into health bar or approaching threat

heavy_door_latch.sounds_like: Heavy wooden dungeon door slam and solid latch shut
heavy_door_latch.use_when: Players trap themselves inside geometry, close an escort door, or get boxed in by cage mechanics
heavy_door_latch.pair_with: ZoomCue on closed door/trap + editorial callout

hero_brass_impact.use_when: Clutch 1-HP survival, epic save, or impossible stunt landing

hitmarker_blip.sounds_like: Short crisp FPS metallic/tech hitmarker click blip
hitmarker_blip.use_when: RPG snipes, one-shot crits, headshots, or mid-air vehicle projectile contacts

hl_scientist_scream.use_when: [MAINSTREAM VOICE BLIP] Violent mauling, animal attack, panicked NPC scream

hl_scientist_stahp.use_when: [MAINSTREAM VOICE BLIP] Sudden interruption, getting hit or robbed unexpectedly

hud_lock_beep.sounds_like: Ultra-short digital camera autofocus electronic lock beep
hud_lock_beep.use_when: Highlighting an overlooked cooldown, unused health pot, or enemy unit (-10 frames before payoff)

huh_meme.use_when: Impossible physics glitch, inexplicable one-shot, or confused NPC behavior

jackpot_loot.use_when: Rare WoW BoE/epic world drop, winning a greed roll, or GTA heist payout
jackpot_loot.pair_with: ZoomCue on loot popup + celebratory caption

metal_pipe_impact.sounds_like: Hollow resonant metal pipe clatter and tonal echo impact
metal_pipe_impact.use_when: Motorcycles hitting obstacles, players ragdolling off car hoods, or absurd blunt collisions

pistol_cock_metallic.sounds_like: Unmistakable sharp metallic handgun slide rack and pistol cock
pistol_cock_metallic.use_when: NPC or player suddenly pulls a handgun/weapon (e.g., NPC pulling a pistol on KingVicss)
pistol_cock_metallic.pair_with: SilenceCue (-0.35s AudioVacuum) + ZoomCue (mode: snap) on weapon + SpotlightCue alert (!)

quack_meme.sounds_like: Short goofy viral cartoon duck quack (Meme Redesign)
quack_meme.use_when: Censoring a swear word, silly fail, or goofy ragdoll bonk

retro_8bit_death.sounds_like: Classic retro 8-bit video game death fall fail tone
retro_8bit_death.use_when: Exact instant a WoW Hardcore character dies / turns into a ghost or mission fails

reverse_cymbal_swell.sounds_like: Fast 1.6-second cinematic reverse cymbal crescendo swell
reverse_cymbal_swell.use_when: Pre-impact tension builder immediately before a vehicular crash, projectile hit, or boss slam

riser_whoosh.sounds_like: Fast studio trailer riser whoosh transition
riser_whoosh.use_when: High-energy buildup into a scene cut, stunt launch, or punchline

rubber_toy_squeak.sounds_like: Funny rubber duck toy compress squeak
rubber_toy_squeak.use_when: Minor head-bumps, failed jumps, bonks, or petty slapstick damage
rubber_toy_squeak.pair_with: Editorial callout caption on bonk frame

sad_trombone_fail.use_when: Embarrassing whiff, missed ultimate, failed jump, or anticlimactic death

shocked_crowd_gasp.sounds_like: Crisp comedic medium audience shocked gasp reaction
shocked_crowd_gasp.use_when: Unexpected jaw-drop reveal, awkward walk-in, or scandalous visual twist (e.g., Speed & Jason bathroom reveal)

slapstick_slip_crash.sounds_like: Crisp cartoon slapstick banana-peel slip into comical body crash foley
slapstick_slip_crash.use_when: Absurd wipeout, grandma scooter crash, or hilarious ragdoll tumble

slide_whistle_fall.sounds_like: Classic cartoon descending slide whistle fall
slide_whistle_fall.use_when: Characters falling off cliffs, failed parachutes, or airborne vehicle drops
slide_whistle_fall.pair_with: Tracking editorial caption over falling subject

sub_drop_bass.sounds_like: Deep 50Hz cinematic sub-bass drop and heavy 808 low boom
sub_drop_bass.use_when: Fatal damage ticks, boss wipes, vehicle collisions, or death hits on Frame 0
sub_drop_bass.pair_with: SilenceCue (-0.35s AudioVacuum) + ShakeCue + SnapZoomBox on impact

superhero_epic_fanfare.sounds_like: Blockbuster superhero movie orchestral brass horns heroic entrance sting
superhero_epic_fanfare.use_when: Dramatic heroic character reveal or over-the-top entrance (e.g., IShowSpeed spotting the Hulk)
superhero_epic_fanfare.pair_with: ImpactSlowMo + ZoomCue (mode: snap) + editorial hero caption

tada_meme.use_when: Sarcastic reveal of a terrible outcome or unexpected stunt landing

tape_stop_slowdown.sounds_like: Analog cassette motor rewind-stop pitch slowdown
tape_stop_slowdown.use_when: Cut-to-silence transition right as a massive mechanical mistake or self-sabotage begins

upbeat_grandma_chase.sounds_like: Playful, quirky 130 BPM instrumental comedy chase groove ('The Tightrope', 25s trimmed)
upbeat_grandma_chase.use_when: High-energy comedic chase or absurd vehicle/scooter pursuit (e.g., GTA 6 grandma scooter chase) to replace unfitting music
upbeat_grandma_chase.pair_with: Audio ducking (-14dB under dialogue) + slapstick_slip_crash on wipeout

vice_city_synth_bed.sounds_like: Sleek 120 BPM 1980s Vice City retro synthwave instrumental groove ('Anticipation', 25s trimmed)
vice_city_synth_bed.use_when: Continuous GTA 6 montage background bed at -22dB for neon Miami / Vice City atmosphere
vice_city_synth_bed.pair_with: Hard-ducked SilenceCue before climax hits + whip_swoosh transitions

vine_boom.sounds_like: Massive studio cinematic low boom hit (Epidemic Sound #1 top boom)
vine_boom.use_when: Deadpan comedic stare, ironic text reveal, eyebrow raise, or sudden realization
vine_boom.pair_with: ZoomCue (mode: snap) on facecam or HUD

vinyl_scratch_stop.use_when: Hubris is instantly interrupted (e.g., player boasts then gets stunned, ragdolled, or dies)

whip_swoosh.use_when: Camera snap-zooms (150%-300%) and fast 4-frame directional scene cuts
whip_swoosh.pair_with: ZoomCue (mode: snap) or hard clip transition

windows_error_meme.sounds_like: Viral Windows critical error fail chime (Meme Redesign)
windows_error_meme.use_when: Player brain freezes, stands in fire, disconnects, or forgets to press Petri/Bubble

wrong_buzzer.sounds_like: Mainstream viral game-show wrong answer buzzer (Meme Redesign)
wrong_buzzer.use_when: Streamer makes a confidently wrong callout or presses the wrong button

yay_cheer_meme.use_when: Ironic celebration after a wipe/crash or genuine hyped victory

meme_avengers_sting_2s.sounds_like: Iconic 2.35s orchestral Avengers brass horn hero sting
meme_avengers_sting_2s.use_when: [MAINSTREAM VOICE BLIP] Superhero chaos, Hulk smash reveal, over-the-top dramatic arrival

meme_what_the_hell_2s.sounds_like: Iconic viral voice 'What the hell, oh my gawd!'
meme_what_the_hell_2s.use_when: [MAINSTREAM VOICE BLIP] Absurd shock, incredulous double-take (Speed seeing Jason in shower, glitchy NPC)

meme_why_are_you_running_2s.sounds_like: Iconic meme voice screaming 'Why are you running?! Why are you running?!'
meme_why_are_you_running_2s.use_when: [MAINSTREAM VOICE BLIP] Chasing someone down, NPC/streamer fleeing in panic, grandma scooter chase

meme_cj_ah_shit_2s.sounds_like: CJ from GTA San Andreas saying 'Ah shit, here we go again'
meme_cj_ah_shit_2s.use_when: [MAINSTREAM VOICE BLIP] Instant regret repeating, stepping back into trouble or GTA NPC confrontation

meme_at_this_moment_2s.sounds_like: Narrator saying 'It was at this moment he knew... he fucked up'
meme_at_this_moment_2s.use_when: [MAINSTREAM VOICE BLIP] Instant regret frame, opening the bear cage, hitting the wrong NPC

meme_wait_a_minute_2s.sounds_like: Kid meme voice saying 'Wait a minute!'
meme_wait_a_minute_2s.use_when: [MAINSTREAM VOICE BLIP] Sudden confusion, bizarre NPC encounter, unexpected interruption

meme_oh_hell_no_2s.sounds_like: Man yelling 'Oh my god bro, hell no man!'
meme_oh_hell_no_2s.use_when: [MAINSTREAM VOICE BLIP] Gross/awkward reveal, incredulous disgust or nope-out moment

meme_fbi_open_up.sounds_like: Voice yelling 'FBI open up!' followed by door breach
meme_fbi_open_up.use_when: [MAINSTREAM VOICE BLIP] Sudden ambush, police busting in, breaking open a door/cage

meme_mission_failed_2s.sounds_like: Call of Duty announcer saying 'Mission failed, we'll get em next time'
meme_mission_failed_2s.use_when: [MAINSTREAM VOICE BLIP] Botched heist, clumsy wipeout, accidentally pushing a bystander

meme_he_need_some_milk.sounds_like: Viral woman yelling 'He need some milk!'
meme_he_need_some_milk.use_when: [MAINSTREAM VOICE BLIP] Heavy ragdoll knockout, mauling, brutal fall or grandma wipeout

meme_nani.use_when: [MAINSTREAM VOICE BLIP] Impossible physics glitch, sudden betrayal or shock turn

meme_no_god_please_no_2s.sounds_like: Michael Scott screaming 'NO! GOD! PLEASE NO!'
meme_no_god_please_no_2s.use_when: [MAINSTREAM VOICE BLIP] Catastrophic fail, helplessly watching disaster unfold (bear attack, robbery)

meme_look_at_this_dude_2s.sounds_like: Viral laugh voice 'Look at this dude!'
meme_look_at_this_dude_2s.use_when: [MAINSTREAM VOICE BLIP] Mocking weird NPC appearance, absurd outfit or clumsy wipeout

meme_directed_by_2s.sounds_like: Iconic Curb Your Enthusiasm 'Directed by Robert B. Weide' ironic punchline stinger
meme_directed_by_2s.use_when: [MAINSTREAM VOICE BLIP] Self-inflicted irony, confident boast followed immediately by failure
